parties.respondent: Haryana State Industrial and Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited & Ors.

summary: Recovery of time-barred debts; Haryana Public Moneys (Recovery of Dues) Act vs Limitation Act; remedy-bar v.s. debt-extinction principle; reliance on V.R. Kalliyanikutty overturned by distinguishing Bombay Dyeing precedent; time-barred loans recoverable under Recovery Act; personal guarantors liable; Recovery Certificate enforcement upheld; writ petitions dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Haryana Public Moneys (Recovery of Dues) Act, 1979
Bombay Dyeing and Manufacturing Company Limited vs. The State of Bombay, 1958 SCR 1122
State of Kerala vs. V.R. Kalliyanikutty, 1999 3 SCC 657
final_judgment: Leave granted; appeal allowed; High Court judgment upheld; recovery proceedings restored.
